concept_ia: Atlas — spatial/cartographic Information Architecture: destinations are bounded regions sized by content density, focus+context workspace with a minimap rail + viewport rail, and a Cmd+K search overlay that dims the map. Concept-owned families are demonstrated as full regions; sibling families are reachable through the shared setting-row grammar and the minimap.
provisional_only_note: All command IDs, schema field names, and component names in this register are provisional concept deltas for audit adjudication. No canon is minted here. Existing catalog.* and UCC IDs are cited as evidence, not modified.

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Atlas demonstrates the search-first Settings surface (F3-432) as a cartographic atlas rather than bloom chips, and the setting-row grammar (F3-438) across all six C2 regions. The category-bloom modal model behind cmd.settings.bloom.open (F3-434 deep-link) is superseded in this concept by region/minimap navigation that preserves the same deep-link + focus-highlight semantics without the bloom silhouette. The notification-surface rule (title-bar stack is the sole in-app affordance; no bottom-right stack, status-bar bell, Activity Bar shortcut, or dedicated side panel) must be reflected in F3-432/F3-433 attention notices. Theme family/mode model (Friendly/Glass/Retro/Basic × Light/Dark/Auto with OS prefers-color-scheme live following) supersedes any 8-flat-enum rendering of general.visual.theme.
plan_owner_impacts.action: record + adjudicate during compile; do not edit canon from this concept

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Atlas exercises the inventory rows for notifications, sound, theme/appearance, tray, window-restore, crash-recovery, and teacher/help. Census gap: there are no inventory rows for spellcheck on/off, dictionary source, personal dictionary, or project dictionary — these must be added (see settings_inventory_impacts). general.visual.theme is an 8-value select; Atlas renders the family/mode model and flags the 8-enum as inventory lineage to reconcile. general.interaction.notification-method/notification-destinations/notification-mapping describe a multi-destination router (8 destinations) that the inventory does not yet model as a structured object.
plan_owner_impacts.action: add missing spellcheck rows; model notification destination as structured object; reconcile theme 8-enum with family/mode

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Schema needs extension for: (a) notification destination objects (kind, channel/thread, headers, template, success_predicate, priority, parse_mode, retry, device_selection), (b) sound asset metadata (source, license, version, duration_seconds, sha256, default_mapping, pack_ref, verification_state), (c) custom theme TOML descriptor (base_theme, family, mode, tokens, schema_validation_result, fallback_theme), (d) dictionary source descriptor (source_kind, language, path_or_ref). The nine-state value model (Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective differs) must be representable per setting row.
plan_owner_impacts.action: extend schema; preserve v1 backward compatibility

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Uploaded sound assets are user-supplied audio, NOT generated media. They must not be modeled under media.image/media.video/media.tts/media.music capability flags. The asset metadata (source, license, version, duration, hash) parallels the generated-media artifact provenance fields but lives in the sound-library domain. Atlas records this boundary so audit does not conflate sound uploads with generated audio/TTS.
plan_owner_impacts.action: keep sound-library uploads out of generated-media capability matrix; cross-reference provenance field shapes only

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Atlas reuses the existing notifications/sound/theme/model command families (UCC-103, UCC-108) verbatim and flags cmd.settings.bloom.open for alias/supersession by atlas region navigation. New candidate families not in canon: theme create/import/export (custom TOML), spellcheck dictionary management, settings manager open navigation, provider installation scan/verify/reconnect, app tray/quit/window-restore, teacher explain-screen. cmd.alert.* (UCC-108: acknowledge/snooze/dismiss/open_source/mute_rule) is a DIFFERENT system (attention alerts/concerns) from cmd.notifications.* (delivery routing) and must not be conflated or aliased.
plan_owner_impacts.action: adjudicate new candidate IDs; retire/alias bloom; record alert vs notification boundary

plan_owner_impacts.impact: Command normalization for atlas navigation (region select, minimap pan, scrollspy jump, manager open) must carry route_target + OpenSubject + panel-context per the route/open contract. Setting mutations remain registry-owned non-command values (F3-438/F3-439/F3-441) — Atlas never turns a setting toggle into a command. One-shot actions (test-send, sound preview, pack import, theme preview/apply) are commands with typed payloads.
plan_owner_impacts.action: ensure atlas nav normalizes to route/open; setting rows stay non-command

settings_inventory_impacts.impact: Render as family + mode (Friendly/Glass/Retro/Basic × Light/Dark/Auto) rather than an 8-value flat select. The 8 options remain valid lineage; the UI groups them. Invalid values that do not resolve under family/mode must be flagged during migration.
Auto must follow OS prefers-color-scheme live and switch without restart. Atlas demonstrates the live OS flip fixture.

Backs the custom-TOML theme manager region. Needs schema-validation result, base-theme inheritance, invalid-theme diagnosis + fallback, and create/import/export/open-folder actions. Inventory row currently implies a flat manage panel.
Master toggle for the 8-destination router. When off, no destination sends; quiet/focus windows still apply to the master.

Must model up to 8 destinations: in-app title-bar stack (sole in-app surface), system/tray, Slack, Discord, generic webhook, ntfy, Pushover, Telegram. Each carries channel/thread, mentions, headers, template, success predicate, priority, parse mode, retry, device selection. Secrets stored as refs only.
Per-event routing to one or more destinations. Event taxonomy must cover blocked work, approval needed, completion, failure, and advisory events. Sound cannot be the only indication of these.

Backs the Sound Library region: built-in + uploaded sounds with source/license/version/duration/hash metadata; PeonPing/OpenPeon-compatible pack import with format + license checks; local-only preview; master volume; import/export; delete/replace.
Resource-list manager for sound assets. Unverified packs are never bundled. Replace-on-delete must preserve mappings or remap explicitly.

Desktop/tray/window region. Tray-while-automation badge, Pause/Resume/Quit, launch destination, and window/panel/tab restore are co-located. Inventory rows exist for minimize-to-tray and tray-notifications but not for launch-destination, tray badge, or Pause/Resume/Quit app-lifecycle controls.

Window/panel/tab restore including crash recovery and unsaved-buffer protection. Inventory rows exist for window-state, crash-restore, unsaved-capture, restore-panel, max-persisted-tabs. Activity-bar reorder/hide/overflow and side-panel restore are not inventoried.

Teacher/Help region anchor (Explain Things To Me). Atlas demonstrates explicit Teacher assistance beyond tooltips: explain-current-screen, guided transitions, tooltip detail. Inventory rows for mode, show-tooltips, explain-disabled, chat-eli5, teach-model exist; explain-current-screen is a new candidate action.

Spellcheck rows are ABSENT from the inventory census: check-spelling on/off, language (Automatic), dictionary source (Automatic/system/PM-local), personal dictionary manage, project dictionary use/manage, check-technical-prose, underline-unknown-names, language packs, thread/project overrides. These must be added under a general.spellcheck.* namespace. NO autocorrect row — grammar/style is a separate opt-in provider-backed feature.

settings_schema_impacts.name: notification_destination_object
settings_schema_impacts.impact: Structured object schema for a single destination: kind enum (in_app_title_bar, system_tray, slack, discord, generic_webhook, ntfy, pushover, telegram), destination_config (channel/thread, mentions[], headers_ref, body_template, success_predicate, priority, parse_mode, retry_policy, device_selection[]), credential_ref (SecretReference, never raw), enabled, last_test_receipt_ref.

settings_schema_impacts.name: sound_asset_metadata
settings_schema_impacts.impact: Object schema: asset_id, source (builtin/uploaded/pack), license, version, duration_seconds, sha256, default_mapping_event, pack_ref, verification_state (verified/unverified/quarantined), display_name. Unverified assets cannot be bundled or auto-mapped to critical events.

settings_schema_impacts.name: custom_theme_descriptor
settings_schema_impacts.impact: TOML-backed theme descriptor: base_theme (Friendly/Glass/Retro/Basic), family, mode (light/dark/auto), token_overrides{}, schema_version, schema_validation_result (valid/invalid_with_fallback), fallback_theme_id, inherited_tokens[]. Invalid TOML falls back to the named base theme and surfaces a diagnosis row.

settings_schema_impacts.name: dictionary_source_descriptor
settings_schema_impacts.impact: Object schema: source_kind (automatic/system_only/pm_local_only), resolved_source (OS service then PM local, when automatic), language, path_or_ref, personal_words[], project_words[]. Personal and project dictionaries are separate scopes.

settings_schema_impacts.name: setting_value_state_enum
settings_schema_impacts.impact: Nine explicit value states (Default/Recommended/Inherited/Auto/Not configured/Managed/Custom/Unavailable/Effective differs). Auto/Inherit/Not configured/Disabled must never render as an empty string. ValueSourceBadge consumes this enum.

settings_schema_impacts.name: tray_window_lifecycle
settings_schema_impacts.impact: Group the tray/window/restore controls under one schema namespace: minimize_to_tray, tray_automation_badge, launch_destination, window_restore, panel_restore, activity_bar_overflow, crash_recovery, unsaved_buffer_protection, editor_tab_tree_limits. App-level Quit/Pause/Resume are actions, not settings.

wiring_impacts: Every Atlas user action traces the 9-step wiring contract (ui_source → command → canonical_owner → validation/permission → state/op → event/receipt/ObservableWork → ui_projection → usage/diagnostic attribution → recovery/deeplink). Full per-flow traces in candidate-wiring-delta.json.

Setting-toggle rows (theme mode, notifications-enabled, sound master volume, dictionary source, minimize-to-tray) remain registry-owned non-command values per F3-438/F3-439/F3-441 — they apply instantly through the wiring map, not through a cmd.* dispatch.

One-shot actions (destination test-send, sound preview, pack import, theme preview/apply, installation scan/verify) are wired commands with ObservableWork phases for long operations and explicit dispatch receipts.
Atlas region/minimap navigation wires through route/open (route_target + OpenSubject + panel-context); no concept-only local state may masquerade as production wiring.
dry_component_impacts: Atlas exercises the full shared DRY family set (see candidate-dry-delta.json): SettingsWorkspaceShell, SettingsSearch (Cmd+K overlay variant), CategoryNavigation (region grid), SubcategoryScrollspy (minimap + viewport rail), SettingRow, ValueSourceBadge, ManagerShell, ResourceList/Card/Detail, HealthSummary, NotificationDestination, SoundLibraryItem, ThemePreview, SetupFlowLauncher, ObservableOperation, ReceiptLink.
Atlas-specific composition: minimap rail reuses SubcategoryScrollspy semantics with a model-backed active-region indicator; viewport rail reuses it with a scroll-position thumb.

SecretField is used for notification destination credentials (webhook URL, bot tokens) and is NEVER used for CLI-owned OAuth (Claude/Antigravity) which stays behind a CLI-owned boundary with no PM-side secret field.
AvailabilityReason is exercised heavily: managed/unavailable theme rows, unverified sound packs, failed/rolled-back installations, system-tray-unavailable, dictionary-source-unavailable.

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Reuse existing settings.theme.updated (cmd.theme.*). New event candidates for adjudication: notifications.destination.tested (rate-limited test-send receipt), sound.pack.imported (with verification_state), sound.asset.replaced, spellcheck.dictionary.updated, provider.installation.scanned/verified/rolled_back, app.window.state.restored. No fabricated *.command_applied events.

Test-send receipts store destination_kind, masked_target, dispatch_id, ack_status, result_status, latency_ms, and failure detail — never the raw secret. Rate-limit state (per-destination window) is local kv.
schema_event_storage_impacts.storage: local JSONL receipt log + kv rate-limit counters

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Asset metadata (source, license, version, duration, sha256, pack_ref, verification_state) is stored as resource records, paralleling generated-media artifact provenance but in the sound domain.
Custom TOML theme validation results (schema_version, valid/invalid_with_fallback, fallback_theme_id, diagnosed_errors[]) cached so startup load does not re-parse invalid themes repeatedly.
schema_event_storage_impacts.storage: local kv cache keyed by theme sha256

schema_event_storage_impacts.impact: Delivered notifications keep an audit trail (event_kind, destination_kind, dispatch_id, receipt_ref) so usage/diagnostic attribution works. This is delivery audit, NOT the cmd.alert.* attention system.

migration_supersession_impacts.reason: Atlas replaces the bloom/chip architecture with bounded regions + minimap navigation. Deep-link + focus-highlight semantics are preserved. Supersession, not removal — keep bloom as compatibility alias only if external callers depend on it.
Packet 01/00_START_HERE: primary category controls must stop reading as filter pills. Atlas regions are destinations with title/purpose/health/navigation, never chips.
Theme selector model is family + mode (Friendly/Glass/Retro/Basic × Light/Dark/Auto). The 8 inventory options are valid lineage but must be grouped, not rendered as a flat 8-row list.
migration_supersession_impacts.canonical_ref: FINDINGS.md theme selector model; settings_inventory.json general.visual.theme

migration_supersession_impacts.reason: Any inventory value that does not resolve under family/mode (or fails TOML schema validation for custom themes) must be diagnosed and fall back to a named base theme during migration, not silently dropped.
Left-shell canon: Activity Bar is the narrow left icon rail controlling one adjacent left side-panel slot. Any right-side-panel Settings descriptions are superseded.
Stale regular/yolo mode coupling is superseded per REFERENCE_SUPERSESSIONS; Atlas mode controls (Explain Things To Me, tooltips) are independent of any retired mode taxonomy.
Retire any bottom-right stack, status-bar bell, Activity Bar notification shortcut, or dedicated Notifications side panel. The title-bar stack is the sole in-app notification affordance.

slint_port_impacts.impact: Slint 1.17.1 cannot rely on runtime CSS var() chains or color-mix(). Theme tokens must be precompiled per F3-431. Live reload (incl. OS prefers-color-scheme flip in Auto mode) requires re-baking the active token set and re-emitting to the scene graph. Invalid-TOML fallback must resolve at load time, not at first paint.
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: precompute token sets; emit a theme-applied signal on reload; keep fallback resolution in the loader

slint_port_impacts.impact: Concept uses the browser HTML audio element for local-only preview. Slint has no DOM; production needs a native audio playback abstraction. Preview must NEVER route through external notification delivery.
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: introduce a PM-local audio-preview service bound to SoundLibraryItem; gate behind cmd.sound.preview

slint_port_impacts.impact: Atlas scrollspy (minimap active-region indicator + viewport-rail scroll thumb) in the browser relies on scroll/resize measurement. Slint forbids arbitrary DOM measurement; use model-backed scroll-position + layout-driven indicators. No uncontrolled scroll jumps (motion rule).
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: drive scrollspy from the Slint ListView item-index model, not pixel measurement; synchronize minimap via model binding

slint_port_impacts.impact: backdrop-filter has no Slint analogue. Glass themes bake one backdrop blur over a pre-baked wallpaper (F3-431/T16). The manager refresh-overlay falls back to an opaque plate under glass (no nested blur).
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: preserve the opaque-plate fallback; re-bake wallpaper at native resolution

slint_port_impacts.impact: The 12-column region grid is a layout spec, not semantic state. Translates to nested VerticalLayout/HorizontalLayout in Slint. Responsive reflow at narrow widths needs manual translation (collapse minimap + viewport rail below 1280px).
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: model regions as a repeater over a category model; let Slint layout containers handle flow

slint_port_impacts.impact: The Cmd+K search overlay dims the map and surfaces results. In Slint this is a popup/focus-scope over the atlas; map-dim is a semi-transparent rectangle, not a filter stack.
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: use Slint PopupWindow + focus-scope; avoid heavy filter stacks

slint_port_impacts.impact: Concept uses the browser spellcheck attribute to simulate underlines. Slint needs a portable spelling-service abstraction for underline rendering. NO autocorrect behavior is ported (grammar/style is separate provider-backed opt-in).
slint_port_impacts.mitigation: introduce a spellcheck-service trait; render underlines via text-decoration equivalent; keep grammar/style behind its own provider gate

test_fixtures.description: All 8 destinations configured: in-app title-bar stack (sole in-app surface), system/tray, Slack, Discord, generic webhook, ntfy, Pushover, Telegram. Includes a failing webhook (4xx) to exercise the success-predicate + retry + receipted failure path. Secrets masked everywhere.

Test-send on a webhook destination: payload masked, rate-limit window enforced (second tap within window is blocked with a receipt), returns a dispatch_id + result_status. Sound cannot be the only indication of completion.

PeonPing/OpenPeon-compatible pack import fails format + license check (unverified). The pack is never bundled; the asset is quarantined; mappings are not auto-applied. Built-in + verified uploaded sounds remain available.
Local-only preview of a built-in and an uploaded sound; preview never triggers external notification delivery. Delete/replace on an uploaded sound remaps the orphaned event mapping explicitly.

Custom TOML theme fails schema validation; falls back to named base theme; diagnosis row shows the error; effective theme is the fallback; live reload + startup load both handle it without a blank surface.
Theme mode = Auto; OS flips light↔dark; PM follows live without restart. Restart markers shown where a token change requires restart (e.g., font swap).
Theme-specific locked (managed) rows and unavailable rows render with AvailabilityReason; UI scale slider with restart marker; custom + fallback fonts.

Dictionary source = Automatic (OS service then PM local), system-only, PM-local-only. Personal + project dictionaries shown as separate scopes. Technical-prose toggle, underline-unknown-names, language packs. NO autocorrect anywhere.
Grammar/style assistance is a separate opt-in provider-backed feature with privacy/route/cost/Usage disclosure. Off by default; turning on shows the disclosure before any route is taken.
Tray-while-automation badge active; Pause/Resume/Quit reachable from tray; minimize-to-tray on; launch destination = last workspace; window/panel/tab restore after a clean relaunch.
Crash recovery restores sessions; unsaved-buffer protection prompts on Quit; editor/tab/tree limits enforced; activity-bar reorder/hide/overflow persisted.
Teacher explains the current screen (Notifications region); guided transition into a real action (open a destination); tooltip detail at hover and keyboard focus.
Provider fixture: CLI found, authenticated, ready. Installation confidence = Proven. Account requested/effective route equal.
CLI found, not signed in. Reconnect action launches the CLI-owned OAuth flow (Claude/Antigravity) — PM never presents PM-direct OAuth for these. API-key connection shown as a separate group.
Update available (Ask first); verification failed; rollback succeeded. Catalog refresh holds last-known-good during the operation.
Free Models row requiring underlying setup; wrapper over routes (owns no credentials); catalog freshness with source version + check/import/activation times.

General fixtures exercised across regions: Default, Custom, Inherited, Managed, Unavailable, Validation error, Restart required, Reconnect required, Setting changed elsewhere, No results, Search typo, Deep-linked setting, Long localized label, Narrow/squeezed layout.

deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: Atlas reserves a System region slot and the shared ManagerShell + ResourceList grammar so a future Server module can drop in as a region + manager without re-architecting the atlas. No server backend state machine is invented here. Deep-link + route/open target reserved.

deferred_named_owners.named_canonical_owner: Release/updates owner + Project Sync owner (per packet 07)
deferred_named_owners.insertion_contract: Atlas does not implement Project Sync or app-update state machines. A System region insertion point is reserved for the Updates manager; route/open target and command wiring deferred to that owner.

unresolved_questions.question: Should the generic open-a-manager wrapper be cmd.settings.manager.open, or should each manager keep a dedicated cmd.settings.open_<family> wrapper (matching the existing cmd.settings.open_notifications / cmd.settings.open_storage_retention pattern)?

Do cmd.alert.* (attention alerts/concerns: acknowledge/snooze/dismiss/mute_rule) and cmd.notifications.* (delivery routing) need a shared receipt taxonomy, or do they stay fully independent event families? Atlas treats them as independent but records the boundary.

Does the custom TOML theme schema live in Plans/settings_inventory.schema.json (as a structured setting value) or in a dedicated Plans/Theme_System.md owner doc with its own schema? Atlas assumes inventory-schema extension but flags the alternative.

App-level tray Pause/Resume vs run-scoped cmd.orchestrator.pause/resume — confirm the tray controls route to app lifecycle (cmd.app.*) and never alias the orchestrator run controls. Naming hazard only, not a semantic conflict.

Atlas region/minimap navigation introduces a region.select + scrollspy.jump candidate. Should these normalize into a single compact cmd.nav.open_subject wrapper over route/open, or stay as settings-scoped commands?
Where exactly do the missing spellcheck inventory rows live (general.spellcheck.*) and what is their tier/exposure? The census shows zero spellcheck rows today.
